summary: Fade a failed NR7 break: after an NR7 bar (narrowest range of last 7), price breaks the NR7 high/low then fails to hold and reverts back inside.
justification: A close-through of a locked NR7 bar that fails to hold and re-closes inside is not a successful NR7 follow, not a single ATR expansion fade, not a volume thrust, not a rolling N-bar failed-range, and not a UTC-day ORB fail.
